snip.t: Transmission of Onchocerca volvulus (causes river blindness/onchocerciasis)

qs.q: Which of the following transmits parasites for river blindness?
qs.e: Simulium (blackflies) transmit Onchocerca volvulus, the cause of river blindness.
qs.s: Medical Bacteriology and Parasitology End of Year 2024/2025

qs.q: What is the pathogen that causes river blindness?
Which of the following transmits parasites for river blindness (Onchocerciasis)?
qs.e: River blindness is caused by the filarial worm Onchocerca volvulus, which is transmitted by the bite of infected blackflies (genus Simulium).
qs.s: Weekly Year 2: Microbiology Exam - September 25, 2026 (Section A: MCQs)

qs.q: The black fly (Simulium species) transmits the parasitic nematode Onchocerca volvulus, which causes river blindness (onchocerciasis).
qs.e: Black flies, belonging to the genus Simulium, are the vectors for the parasite Onchocerca volvulus, the causative agent of onchocerciasis, commonly known as river blindness. This disease is prevalent in parts of Africa and Latin America.
qs.s: Weekly Year 2: Microbiology Exam - June 12, 2026 (Section A: MCQs)

qs.q: Which of the following transmits parasites that cause river blindness?
qs.e: River blindness (onchocerciasis) is transmitted by the bite of infected blackflies (genus Simulium).

qs.q: Which of the following transmits the parasitic nematodes responsible for river blindness (onchocerciasis)?
qs.e: River blindness is caused by the parasite Onchocerca volvulus, which is transmitted by the bite of infected blackflies (Simulium species).
qs.s: Weekly Year 2: Microbiology Exam - May 22, 2026 (Section A: MCQs)

qs.q: Which of the following arthropods is the primary vector for transmitting parasites that cause river blindness (onchocerciasis)?
qs.e: Onchocerciasis is transmitted by the bite of infected female black flies (Simulium species), which breed in fast-flowing rivers and streams.
qs.s: Weekly Year 2: Microbiology Exam - May 15, 2026 (Section A: MCQs)

qs.q: Which of the following transmits the parasites responsible for River Blindness (Onchocerciasis)?
qs.e: Onchocerca volvulus is transmitted by the bite of the Simulium blackfly.
